watchpoints.issue: This functions as a legal-corpus threshold, not merely an altar topic.

watchpoints.issue: Intercession turns to messenger/presence announcement and communal mourning.

watchpoints.issue: Declaration, prohibitions, festivals, and inscription mix forms.

watchpoints.issue: Command, execution, glory response, and travel notice are distinct forms.
watchpoints.remedy: Retain only with command-to-execution-to-validation-to-travel rationale; otherwise test 40:16 and 40:34.
